headline.fr: France : PMS établis + téléconsultations niche ; wearables GPS dominent le grand public.

threats.en: Sticky PMS habits; owner “another app” fatigue; GPS players (Tractive, Invoxia) own “pet monitoring” mindshare. Risk of confusion with pure teleconsultation.
